description: Ministry of Education - Declaration of the Sri Lanka Principals' Service Teacher Advisors' Service and the Sri Lanka Teachers' Service as Classed Services
reasoning: This gazette content declares three specific public services (Sri Lanka Principals' Service, Teacher Advisors' Service, and Sri Lanka Teachers' Service) as "Closed Services" and outlines provisions regarding their administration, including appointments, promotions, disciplinary proceedings, transfers, salary structures, and service minutes. This falls under public sector service administration and establishment matters, which aligns with Type 8 (Public Service Gazettes) covering public service recruitment, service conditions, and administrative instructions for public sector services.
